item.title: Local Lookout: Weston County Clerk trial | Harm reduction vending machines | Water rate hikes - WyoFile
item.description: A trial to remove Weston County Clerk Becky Hadlock from office is scheduled for April 13. Two vending machines will sell items designed to help people minimize harm. Expensive infrastructure projects drive up water costs in Jackson. Cheyenne’s Downtown Development Authority works to rebuild public trust.

item.title: Lawmakers in Wyoming, other states push to protect crisis pregnancy centers as abortion clinic numbers shrink - WyoFile
item.description: Wyoming’s version of the law passed the Legislature earlier this month. It bars government entities from adopting rules that target the centers based on their anti-abortion views.

item.title: Wyoming mountain lions evaded hunters this season because of sparse snow, record heat - WyoFile
item.description: Difficult hunting conditions gave some pressured cougar populations a reprieve, pleasing some local houndsmen who had the hills to themselves.

item.title: Opinion | SAVE Act might save Trump, but it would punish Wyoming’s rural voters
item.description: It’s a complex bill for a nonexistent problem, writes columnist Kerry Drake, who adds it could disenfranchise tens of thousands of legal voters here.

item.title: High temps, dry conditions and blustery winds likely to bring more precautionary power outages - WyoFile
item.description: Wary of wildfires, along with litigation and higher insurance premiums, utilities are preemptively "de-energizing" power lines.

item.title: Wyoming has one university. Can it survive its own Legislature? - WyoFile
item.description: The state’s flagship dodged a $40 million cut, but not the bigger questions it raised.

item.title: Opinion | Rolling back roadless protections puts Wyoming’s water at risk
item.description: Voters expect decisions that protect the resources communities depend on — not policies that risk long-term damage for short-term gain, writes guest columnist Justin Hayes.

item.title: Opinion | High temps and no snow? What happened to our Wyoming winter?
item.description: Humans contribute to climate change, especially politicians who only want to protect fossil fuels, columnist Kerry Drake opines.

item.title: Two southwest Wyoming towns brace for water restrictions - WyoFile
item.description: Mountain View and Lyman prepare residents for cuts while holding out hope for spring snow.

item.title: Local Lookout: Teachers seeking office | Pruning pronghorn protections | Controlling avalanches with drones - WyoFile
item.description: School district tweaks policy to address the possibility of teachers winning seats in Wyoming’s citizen Legislature. Working group discusses shrinking proposed protections for migrating pronghorn. Drone company wants to bring avalanche tech to Wyoming.

item.title: Judge denies request to add Wyoming's new anti-abortion law to ongoing lawsuit - WyoFile
item.description: The group of abortion rights defenders contesting the new "heartbeat" law must now file a separate complaint to challenge the measure.

item.title: Wyoming faces grimmest snowpack in recorded history - WyoFile
item.description: At a time of year when mountain snowpack usually peaks, record heat and little precipitation have created an unseasonably early melt that’s already run its course in some basins.

item.title: Opinion | God requires the rich pay their fair share
item.description: Across-the-board tax cuts concentrate wealth where it already exists, make our communities less safe and jeopardize our children’s futures, writes the Rev. Delaney Piper.

item.title: Opinion | A trainload of frogs
item.description: As Wyoming and the West weather another stretch of drought, columnist Rod Miller remembers his granddad’s creative solution for watering dry ground.

item.title: Trump administration moves Forest Service HQ to the West - WyoFile
item.description: Governor touts relocation as beneficial to Wyoming, USDA says move doesn’t impact forest, district offices.
